name: Urrácal (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Urrácal (a tower on blue above waves).
history: Urrácal was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in February 2000 to adopt its symbols but did not do so until early 2007; the flag is described as a blue flag of dimensions 2:1 with the local arms at its centre.
